name: nds
statement: The Nintendo DS as a prototype: the ARM9 (ARMv5TE) and the ARM7 (ARMv4T) on one set of ARM/Thumb instruction cards, the memory maps, I/O (interrupts, IPC, timers, DMA, divider, cartridge bus), an HLE BIOS, VRAM banks and both 2D engines drawing two screens, the SPI devices (power management, firmware, touch screen), the save chip, the real-time clock, the sound mixer and the 3D engine (geometry and rendering); direct boot from a ROM image. What the games touch that no card models is in the coverage report of `cardmodel machine nds ROM`.

screens.layout: top then bottom, RGB888 (export array screen)

buttons_layout: the host's button mask: bits 0-9 are KEYINPUT's (0x04000130: A B Select Start Right Left Up Down R L), bits 10-11 EXTKEYIN's X and Y (0x04000136, ARM7); both registers read 0 for a pressed button
